title: Filing brief
description: What a filings pull contains: one paragraph, a table of the filings, and the shape of them over time.

slots.name: summary
slots.prompt: In at most 80 words, say what this set of filings is: which forms, over what dates, filed by whom. Use only the values given. Do not estimate or total anything that is not in them.

slots.name: filings
slots.prompt: Choose the columns worth showing for these filings, from the declared list, in the order a reader scans them.

slots.name: by_month
slots.prompt: Name the columns that show how the filings fall over time. Name columns only; the values are read from the rows.
